entities.summary: Florence Nakiwala Kiyingi, is a Ugandan businesswoman and politician. She is the current presidential advisor for Youth and Children Affairs in Uganda. She was appointed to this position on 6 June 2021. She is the former Minister of State for Youth and Children Affairs in the Cabinet of Uganda. She was appointed to that position on 6 June 2016 to 6 June 2021 She is also the Federation of Uganda Football Associations third Vice-President, the first woman to hold that position in Uganda. As well she serves as the Chairperson Commonwealth Youth Ministers Task force voted to that position in 2017.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Florence Nakiwala Kiyingi's appointment as presidential advisor for Youth and Children Affairs in Uganda has significant regional impact, particularly in promoting youth development and children's welfare. Her leadership role in the Federation of Uganda Football Associations also highlights her influence in East African sports.
